digest.component_or_area: gate workflow step and plan review decision kernel
propositions: The gate step computes and discards severity_label result unnecessarily; it is already tested elsewhere and should be removed from decide.py

The gate workflow step fails on both fail_on_severity and priority_threshold, but fail_on_severity is an unwired sample-only policy per ADR 0108 and must be removed from steps.py along with its schema references
The REBAR_VERIFY_PREFETCH environment variable controls file-impact prefetch via a conditional in gate_ops.py, but the A/B test is finished and the feature should always be on
Schema definitions in gate_input.schema.json and plan_review_verdict.schema.json still reference severity in findings, but severity is being deprecated in favor of priority per ADR 0108
Tests currently validate gate behavior driven by severity; they must be rewritten to use priority and max_findings constraints instead
The REBAR_VERIFY_PREFETCH env var must be marked stale in mechanism-baseline.json and removed from auto-generated documentation
